text:
incidentbot: PAGED @on-call for incidents: HIGH error-rate observed for Ventana (dedicated VPC, canary slice). Alerts: 5xx spike + token timeouts. Pager details: https://redwood.ops/alerts/INC-17685 :rotating_light:
sara-oncall: on it. grabbing logs & tracing. assigning priority = customer-impact-high. Ventana CSM is ben-csm.

matt-runtime: thanks. quick context: they were on canary artifact a1b2c3f (quantized build). performance telemetry shows 3x median latency and a few OOM-like failures on dedicated pool nodes. suspect kernel mismatch after last runtime opt.

lia-sre: are errors across whole pool or only specific tenants? can we confirm if only Ventana traffic is hitting affected nodes?

matt-runtime: initial query: mostly Ventana but we see a handful of other small tenants with retries. looks like routing placed Ventana canary on subset of warm hosts that also serve mixed traffic. artifact a1b2c3f is pinned on 6 canary slots.

olga-eng-platform: if it's an artifact-level regression, safest fast path is to pin those canary slots back to previous artifact a1b2c2e. we have deployment record: deploybot shows last stable at a1b2c2e.

deploybot: Rollback candidate identified. Command template: 
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --pool dedicated-ventana --from-artifact a1b2c3f --to-artifact a1b2c2e --staged
```

ben-csm: i'm messaging Ventana (P1 contact list) now: letting them know we're investigating and may roll back canary. asking for any latency observed on their side and if they have requests in flight to avoid mid-request churn.

alex-network: double-checking VPC egress/NAT — last night we rotated NAT gateways for that region; could be amplifying timeouts. running `tcpdump` on the affected host set.

lia-sre: two quick safety checks before rollback: 1) ensure we can isolate Ventana traffic to their dedicated slice to avoid collateral impact; 2) verify KV-cache priming won't cause a spike after rollback.

matt-runtime: agree. propose flow: 1) isolate Ventana to quarantine slice (no shared tenants) 2) staged rollback on canary hosts (1 host at a time) 3) monitor 5m telemetry window for errors & latencies 4) if stable, expand rollback; if not, full revert and preserve logs for RCA.

olga-eng-platform: to isolate: `redwoodctl tenant quarantine --tenant ventana --pool dedicated-ventana --mode staged` will move weights and prevent new cross-tenant allocation. doing dry-run now.

deploybot: quarantine dry-run successful. Ready to execute staged rollback on host h-ventana-03 first.

matt-runtime: executing staged rollback on h-ventana-03 -> running: 
```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --host h-ventana-03 --to-artifact a1b2c2e
```

incidentbot: ACTION: Sara (on-call) to coordinate customer comms; Matt to run rollback; Lia to monitor SLOs; Olga to watch pool orchestration; Alex to watch network. Priority: keep customer requests served; avoid broad pool churn.

sara-oncall: pinged Ventana: "We may run a staged rollback to previous model artifact to restore latency; we'll avoid mid-request disruption where possible. ETA first assessment 10m."

lia-sre: h-ventana-03 rollback completed. telemetry: latency down ~35%, error rate down from 12%->3% on that host. continuing to watch.

matt-runtime: rolling next host h-ventana-01. scheduling 90s drain per host. note: cache warmups may add transient token costs.

alex-network: no network anomalies found on host set. NAT rotations look clean. nothing else contributing.

ben-csm: Ventana replied: "Thanks. Please proceed — we can pause new heavy jobs for 30m." :thumbsup:

lia-sre: after two hosts rolled (03,01) pooled metrics look stable; overall latency improved to baseline and customer error rate down to 1.4%. proposing to finish staged rollback on remaining canary hosts.

olga-eng-platform: staging full rollback now. running `redwoodctl rollout status --pool dedicated-ventana` and will abort if any regression.

deploybot: Full rollback to a1b2c2e completed across canary slice. status: SUCCESS.

matt-runtime: monitoring 10m rolling window. everything green so far. will leave quarantine in place for 20m to ensure no cross-tenant noise.

lia-sre: FYI opened incident ticket INC-17685 and linked logs + gcore dumps to postmortem. tagging for RCA: runtime-team, platform, network.

ben-csm: informing the Ventana tech lead of completion and asking for a quick verification on their side.

incidentbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation complete — staged rollback performed, customer traffic stabilized. Incident remains open for RCA.

sara-oncall: handing off to night on-call @lia-sre for continued monitoring & RCA coordination. I'll update the incident channel and customer thread. thanks all for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:

lia-sre: taking over. next steps: collect kernel logs, compare artifact a1b2c3f vs a1b2c2e, reproduce locally, and schedule postmortem meeting in 48h.

ben-csm: adding Ventana Ops call at +30m to confirm service health.

sara-oncall: closing loop here for the immediate action. Will post timeline and key commands used in the incident doc.

olga-eng-platform: note: recommend adding artifact compatibility gate to deployment pipeline to detect this specific regression earlier. filing infra ticket INF-8942.

matt-runtime: ack — will pair with infra on the compatibility gate.

incidentbot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. assigned: lia-sre.
